extracted.name: Mom's Best Waffles
extracted.description: My mom makes the best waffles and I thought I'd share the recipe with the world!
instruction_lines: In a large bowl, stir together flour, baking powder, sugar and salt. Add milk, eggs and oil; mix well.
Spray preheated waffle iron with non-stick cooking spray. Pour mix onto hot waffle iron. Cook until golden brown.
